decision: Replace the button-still merge with plainFace + live and the dialog spread+card merge with card + spreadInCard

evidence: overlap.mjs after the edit: 0 cycles over 1183 namespaces; rank histogram 0:203 1:132 2:16 3:4 4:1 5:1

evidence: same 243 top-level rules, site-diff base vs new /blog 1440+390 both themes 0 style 0 struct

decision: Carry comments through regeneration with a restoration lever
why: The codemod regenerates src, so hand-restored comments would be lost on the next run

decision: Freeze the codemod sweep into one commit, then clean up as ordinary commits
